=== Possible Robert Glasgow, St Vincent appointment and Ayrshire records, 1785–1799 ===
Robert Glasgow, formerly a hospital mate in the West Indies, is announced for appointment as surgeon to the forces on St Vincent.<ref>[https://www.newspapers.com/image/32859455/ The Times, 1785-12-12, p.2].</ref>

Dr Robert Glasgow at Loudoun is listed among subscribers after an Ayrshire heritors’ meeting.<ref>[https://www.newspapers.com/image/601815997/ The Edinburgh Advertiser, 1793-04-09, p.3].</ref>

Robert Glasgow, Esq. of Montgreenan, is named in a lodged claim for enrolment on Ayr’s roll of freeholders.<ref>[https://www.newspapers.com/image/601821728/ The Edinburgh Advertiser, 1799-08-06, p.2].</ref><ref>[https://www.newspapers.com/image/395726257/ The Caledonian Mercury, 1799-08-08, p.1].</ref>

The exact Montgreenan designation supports identification of the 1799 claimant. The St Vincent surgeon and Loudoun doctor are compatible earlier identities, but the notices do not expressly join them. A lodged claim is not accepted enrolment, and a subscription is not proof of payment.

This may concern [[Glasgow-1076]]. Exact Montgreenan designation agrees with the prior checked 1802 record; earlier St Vincent/doctor contexts fit, but cross-record identity remains inferred.
